rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for an established custom or generally followed practice.

example.english: This practice has already become an industry convention.
example.traditional: 呢個做法已經成為行業慣例。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zou6 faat3 ji5 ging1 sing4 wai4 hong4 jip6 gwaan3 lai6

rows.note: Use this for the all-purpose idea of a large or formal organized convention or gathering.

example.english: The convention will take place in Tokyo next month.
example.traditional: 下個月嘅大會會喺東京舉行。
example.jyutping: haa6 go3 jyut6 ge3 daai6 wui2 wui5 hai2 dung1 ging1 geoi2 hang4

rows.note: Choose this when the convention is being understood specifically as a meeting for discussion or deliberation rather than as a large event.

example.english: This convention is mainly to discuss the new proposal.
example.traditional: 呢次會議主要係商量新方案。
example.jyutping: ni1 ci3 wui6 ji5 zyu2 jiu3 hai6 soeng1 loeng4 san1 fong1 on3

rows.note: Use this specifically for a formal assembly made up of mandated delegates.

example.english: Delegates from various places will vote at the convention.
example.traditional: 各地代表會喺代表大會上表決。
example.jyutping: gok3 dei6 doi6 biu2 wui5 hai2 doi6 biu2 daai6 wui2 soeng6 biu2 kyut3
